about: L4 mesh-zoo fixture and goldens (the test strategy, sections 3.1 and 3.3). Rendered by the exported viewer's --test-render at 640x360 with Stage.MeshCamera (near ~7 m, fov 60: LOD 3; far ~40 m, fov 11: LOD 1), the fixed test environment and light, no MSAA/TAA/FXAA, from the core's world state through the presentation coordinator (RenderingServer). The assets are fetched through SessionAssets from this folder and decoded by the guarded decoder. Tolerance: the terrain goldens' (fixtures/terrain/manifest.json). Goldens are proposed by the render script and approved by a person after viewing.

fixture.provenance: assets built with LibreMetaverse 3.1.6's own encoder (MeshZooBuilder); layout by Viewer.Shell.MeshZoo.Make() (MeshZooTests checks the file against it)
fixture.redistribution: generated in this repo; no third-party content
fixture.negative_control: --tr-alter=vertex: the cube's high-LOD top-face centre vertex raised 1 m after decoding; must fail the diff
